findings.evidence: The heading promises "Typed context (v8, or v7 with middleware on)", but the example imports "createContext" and uses "Route.MiddlewareFunction" without a minor-version gate. The earlier version table explicitly includes pre-7.9 middleware. Following that branch on those releases fails because the middleware APIs still have unstable-prefixed names.
findings.fix: Split the middleware instructions at v7.9: use the unprefixed APIs for v7.9+ and v8; for earlier middleware-capable v7 releases, show unstable_createContext, unstable_RouterContextProvider and the corresponding unstable middleware exports/types with future.unstable_middleware. Alternatively, explicitly require upgrading to v7.9+ before applying this example.
